bullets: Designed and developed a full-stack web application to connect mentors and mentees using the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).
Implemented user authentication, real-time messaging, and session scheduling features.
Created RESTful APIs to manage user profiles, availability, and mentorship requests.
Integrated JWT-based authentication for secure access and route protection.
Deployed the app using cloud services and followed Git-based version control and agile workflows.
Focused on clean, maintainable code and scalability to support future feature expansion.
